systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Technical Education
systems.tiers: national; 'EMIS-linked daily attendance monitoring' introduced by the 2024/25 school year, with weekly attendance dashboards; regional EMIS capacity varies by governorate

systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Technical Education with CAPMAS, which validates the administrative data
systems.tiers: national, yearly (2024 and 2025 datasets named); counts of 25.8 million students, 52,375 public and 9,681 private schools and 1.26 million teachers, sent to UIS, World Bank EdStats and ITU
36,878 of 42,931 schools meet smart school criteria; more than 54,000 schools with reliable internet; primary schools average 95 students per device

note: No fact: the author, an adviser to the minister, says EMIS-linked daily attendance monitoring was introduced and attendance rose above 80% nationwide by the end of 2024/25, with weekly attendance dashboards, but does not say that schools enter a record per learner, who enters it, at which levels or in how many schools; the EMIS is therefore left unclassified. If the parent reads daily attendance monitoring as entry during the year, this is the document that carries it.
